docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
A first-year university course in general chemistry: matter and measurement, atomic structure, the periodic table, chemical bonding, the states of matter, solutions, acids and bases, equilibrium, kinetics, thermodynamics and electrochemistry.

From Wikibooks · CC BY-SA 4.0

General Chemistry, a Wikibooks textbook, by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikibooks when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0. Modified: converted to this format.
